cases.translation: This is the genealogy of Adam's descendants.
cases.explain: Родословие is the grammatical subject presented by вот, so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.translation: This is the genealogy of the descendants of Adam.
cases.explain: The genitive case here expresses possession — the descendants belonging to Adam.

cases.translation: He made him in the likeness of God.
cases.explain: The preposition по meaning 'according to' governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Он сотворил мужчину и ___ и благословил их.
cases.translation: He created male and female and blessed them.
cases.explain: Женщину is the direct object of the transitive verb сотворил (created), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он утешит нас в работе, в тяжком труде рук наших, на земле, проклятой ___.
cases.translation: He will comfort us in our labor and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground the Lord has cursed.
cases.explain: The instrumental case here expresses the agent of the passive participle проклятой — 'cursed by the Lord.'

cases.sentence: Он утешит нас в работе, в тяжком ___ рук наших.
cases.translation: He will comfort us in our labor, in the hard toil of our hands.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating a state or activity governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Когда Бог сотворил человека, Он создал его по подобию Божьему.
reading.question: In whose likeness did God create man?
reading.explain: The text says God created man 'по подобию Божьему' — in the likeness of God.

reading.ru: Всего Адам жил 930 лет и умер.
reading.question: How many years did Adam live in total?
reading.explain: The text states 'Всего Адам жил 930 лет и умер' — in total Adam lived 930 years and died.

reading.ru: Енох ходил с Богом, потом его не стало, потому что Бог взял его.
reading.question: What happened to Enoch instead of dying?
options: God took him, and he was no more
He turned into an angel visibly
reading.correct: God took him, and he was no more
reading.explain: The text says Enoch walked with God, 'потом его не стало, потому что Бог взял его' — then he was no more, for God took him.

reading.ru: Всего Мафусал жил 969 лет и умер.
reading.question: Who lived the longest according to this chapter, at 969 years?
reading.explain: The text says 'Всего Мафусал жил 969 лет и умер' — Methuselah lived 969 years in total, the longest lifespan listed.

reading.ru: Он назвал его Ной и сказал, «Он утешит нас в работе, в тяжком труде рук наших, на земле, проклятой Господом».
reading.question: What did Lamech say about his son Noah?
options: That he would comfort them in their toil on the cursed ground
That he would be a great warrior
That he would build a city
reading.correct: That he would comfort them in their toil on the cursed ground
reading.explain: Lamech says of Noah, 'Он утешит нас в работе, в тяжком труде рук наших' — he will comfort us in our labor.
